constant RealizesTarget : (W : PITWitnessFamily) -> BridgeWitness W -> Prop

theorem pit_witness_family_if_mathrm_pit_in_pclass_or_even_suitable_infinitely_often_derandomisations_in_nondeterministic_subexponential_time_in_standard
    (W : PITWitnessFamily)
    (hW : Admissible W) :
    exists w : BridgeWitness W, PresInv W w /\ RealizesTarget W w

theorem prove_that_a_hitting_set_or_pseudorandom_generator_family_preserves_pit_semantic_object_while_transporting_the_route_from_the_black_box_pit_regime_to_the_arithmetic_circuits_regime_strongly_enough_to_derive_if_mathrm_pit_in_pclass_or_even_suitable_infinitely_often_derandomisations_in_nondeterministic_subexponential_time_in_standard
    (W : PITWitnessFamily)
    (hW : Admissible W) :
    exists w : BridgeWitness W, PresInv W w
